scope: Targeted read-only code review and existing regression checks for an article-led system plan; no new research experiment or evaluator modification

verification.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_search_ir_formula_contract.py tests/test_search_ir_architecture_plan.py tests/test_search_ir_llm_planner.py tests/test_search_ir_rtl_verify.py tests/test_search_ir_ddc.py
verification.limitations: Existing targeted tests only; no full-repository regression, new timing measurement, full-domain proof, paid LLM call, or formal search run

findings.observation: Returns success when architecture compilation succeeds; its loop does not consume chain-quality or synthesis feedback.

Development evaluation status ok means measurement succeeded with legal FIR mask. The verification entry point does not compare measured Q_dev against formula_request.requirements.quality.maximum. This is a deployment acceptance gap, not a claim that the measured candidate failed its numerical budget.

Standalone verifier assumes fixed input-index-to-output timing, holds out_ready high, and does not drive a generic accepted-transaction scoreboard. Other tests already cover selected output-backpressure behavior.
Synthesis contract sets sdc to null, timing_power_claims_allowed to false and microarchitecture_search to false. The public plan grammar lacks pipeline and iterative-resource choices.
Validates nodes against the fixed DDC graph; explicit formula input currently does not imply general formula compilation.

Legacy rne is documented and implemented as adding a half unit before arithmetic shift. A future semantic schema should state tie behavior explicitly and preserve historical semantics through versioning.
